title: Penang flash floods due to 'perfect storm' of factors | The Star
text: Penang flash floods due to 'perfect storm' of factors | The Star × View Nation Penang flash floods due to 'perfect storm' of factors By CHRISTOPHER TAN Tuesday, 19 Jul 2016 | 5:19 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Metro News 1d ago RM75mil for tech development in Penang Nation 1d ago Penang Domestic Trade Ministry destroys over 58,000 counterfeit, seized Items worth RM3mil Nation 9h ago Penang issues notices to nine litterbugs under new community service rule Penang floods. BALIK PULAU: Heavy rains of up to 80mm per hour, a high tide and an undersized culvert are said to have caused the flash floods in Kampung Teluk Awak, Kampung Nelayan and Jalan Hassan Abas in Teluk Bahang here. Teluk Bahang assemblyman Datuk Shah Headan Ayoob Hussain Shah said that heavy rainfall of 80mm per hour was recorded between 1pm and 2pm on Monday. Already a subscriber?
